items.title: morluto/rea
items.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
items.author: morluto
items.summary_zh: morluto/rea 是一个把 agent 用在逆向工程上的 GitHub 项目，覆盖范围从 App 行为分析一路下探到 native 二进制层面。它让自动化智能体去驱动整个逆向流程，而不是只做单一的反汇编，适合安全研究、漏洞分析和需要摸清闭源程序内部逻辑的开发者。
items.summary_en: rea is a GitHub project that applies agents to reverse engineering, spanning app behaviour analysis all the way down to native binaries. Rather than being a single-purpose disassembler, it aims to let autonomous agents drive the investigation, which makes it relevant to security researchers and anyone who needs to understand closed-source software.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇掘金上的使用体验分享，作者把日常开发从 Cursor 切到 Codex，用了大半个月后记录下真实感受。在他看来 Cursor 更像一个 AI 编程助手，而 Codex 更接近能自己完成任务的 agent 形态。适合正在 Cursor 和 Codex 之间做选择的开发者参考。
items.summary_en: A Juejin post in which a developer describes spending roughly half a month in Codex after switching from Cursor. His takeaway is that Cursor still reads as an AI coding assistant, while Codex feels closer to a general-purpose agent that carries out tasks on its own. Useful for developers deciding which tool to adopt for daily work.

items.title: 日媒曝黑客黑掉软银旗下云平台后留下 225 封勒索信，结果运维找 7 小时没发现勒索信只是一味重启，如何看待？
items.summary_zh: 据日媒报道，黑客入侵软银旗下云平台后留下了 225 封勒索信，运维团队排查 7 小时却始终没有发现这些信件，只是一味重启系统。事件暴露的是检测与响应环节的缺口：入侵已经完成、勒索信息已经落地，防守方仍未能判断事件性质。原文为链接，未提供更多细节。
items.summary_en: Japanese media reported that attackers who breached a cloud platform under SoftBank left 225 ransom notes, yet the operations team spent seven hours without finding any of them and simply kept rebooting systems. The incident points to a detection and response gap rather than the intrusion itself. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

items.title: 突发：OpenAI dots全面登陆手机，开口指挥Codex干活了
items.summary_zh: 36氪消息称，OpenAI 的 dots 已全面登陆手机端，用户可以直接开口指挥 Codex 干活。若属实，这意味着 Codex 的交互从键盘输入扩展到语音入口，在手机上委派编码任务会变得更直接。原文为链接，未提供更多细节。
items.summary_en: A 36Kr report says OpenAI's dots has rolled out fully on mobile, letting users issue spoken instructions to Codex. If accurate, it extends Codex from typed prompts to a voice-driven entry point, which matters for developers who want to delegate coding tasks away from a desktop. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

items.title: Codex 和 Claude Code 都跑偏了，前 OpenAI 研究员称 Jev 出现前 AI 世界是个悲剧
items.summary_zh: Jev 创始人、TypeSafe CEO Diogo Almeida 在 Latent Space 播客中称，Codex 和 Claude Code 仍停留在“AI 辅助人”的同一阶段。他提出的 RLCD（面向校准决策的强化学习）让模型输出代码可直接使用的选择、评分与概率，开发者按不确定性设阈值决定自动执行还是交给人，目标是把智能变成像数据库一样的普通能力。
items.summary_en: Diogo Almeida, TypeSafe CEO and founder of Jev, told the Latent Space podcast that Codex and Claude Code belong to the same era in which AI merely assists humans. His answer is RLCD, reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions, which has models emit choices, scores and probabilities that code can consume directly, letting developers set thresholds on uncertainty for when to act and when to hand off.

items.title: [酷工作] 上海外企一年 contract 的职位： iOS/Android 开发，英语流利，月薪 60-70k，需要去现场办公
items.summary_zh: 上海一家外企放出一年期 contract 的 iOS/Android 开发职位，月薪 60-70k，要求英语流利且需现场办公。Android 岗要求 3 年以上 Android SDK 经验与 5 年以上 Java 等语言经验，iOS 岗要求 3 年以上 iOS SDK 以及 Swift、SwiftUI 经验，Play Store 上架、A/B testing、SQL 属加分项。
items.summary_en: A foreign company in Shanghai is hiring iOS and Android developers on a one-year contract at 60-70k RMB per month, with fluent English required and on-site work. The Android role asks for 3+ years with the Android SDK and 5+ years in Java and other languages, while the iOS role wants 3+ years with the iOS SDK plus Swift and SwiftUI; bonuses include shipped Play Store apps, A/B testing and SQL.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 掘金一篇面试向文章指出，2026 年的技术面试已经和两年前不同：那时问的是「手写一个 Promise」「React Fiber 原理」，现在面试官默认你会用 AI，真正想知道的是——AI 都能写 80% 代码了，公司为什么还需要你。适合正在准备面试、想调整答题思路的开发者。
items.summary_en: A Juejin article argues the 2026 technical interview has changed: where two years ago candidates were asked to hand-write a Promise or explain React Fiber, interviewers now assume you work with AI and ask something else — if AI can write 80% of the code, why does the company still need you? Useful for developers preparing interviews and rethinking how they answer.

items.title: [程序员] 哎 程序员还有饭吃嘛

items.summary_en: A developer vents on V2EX that coding bots have gotten so capable they wonder what programmers are supposed to do next. The post is just one sentence, with no further detail or discussion attached.

items.title: OpenAI 高管亲述：我们是怎么在一周内做出 Jev 竞品的
items.summary_zh: InfoQ 编译了 Latent Space 播客对 OpenAI 计算机操作团队与 API 平台负责人的访谈：每个 Dot 智能体拥有独立云端 Linux 电脑，可操作浏览器和桌面应用；受 Jev 启发启动的 Decisions API 约一周做出可运行原型，沿用 Luna 权重、未重新训练模型。访谈还谈到智能体如何排错重试、以及人工应在哪些环节把关，适合做 Agent 产品的开发者。
items.summary_en: InfoQ translated a Latent Space podcast interview with OpenAI's computer-use and API platform leads: each Dot agent gets its own cloud Linux machine and can drive browsers and desktop apps, while the Decisions API — started after seeing Jev — reached a working prototype in about a week by reusing Luna weights instead of retraining. The talk also covers how agents recover from errors and where humans should stay in the loop.

items.title: @ 一下就能派活？谷歌推出办公 Agent，拥有独立账号、能够创建子 Agent，还能调用 Claude
items.summary_zh: 谷歌云在 10 月 8 日的 Gemini at Work 2026 活动上推出企业级通用 AI Agent——Gemini agent，由 CEO Thomas Kurian 介绍。它用一个提示框就能完成内容创作、问答和代码执行等任务，可创建子 Agent 协作；企业能为它分配专属邮箱、日历和持久化存储，让它以团队成员身份长期工作，底层还支持调用 Anthropic Claude。打通 Workspace 与 Slack、Jira 等第三方工具是它的主要卖点。
items.summary_en: At its Gemini at Work 2026 event on October 8, Google Cloud launched Gemini agent, an enterprise general-purpose AI agent introduced by CEO Thomas Kurian. It handles content creation, Q&A and code execution from a single prompt, can spin up sub-agents, and can be given its own email, calendar and persistent storage so it works as a long-term team member; it can also call Anthropic's Claude. Integration spans Workspace plus third-party tools like Slack, Jira and Salesforce.

items.title: [创业组队] 寻找技术合伙人｜一起做陪诊、陪护数字化平台 “PAPA”
items.summary_zh: 独立开发者正为陪诊陪护平台 PAPA 招技术合伙人，已完成半年市场调研，目标客户是承接三甲医院服务的外包公司，目前尚未签约或产生收入。项目已有网站、微信小程序和后端代码，技术栈为 React、Node.js、MySQL，部分流程通过本地测试，仍需接口联调、权限隔离与部署。适合能接手现有代码、独立排查问题并对交付负责的前后端开发者。
items.summary_en: A solo developer is looking for a technical co-founder for PAPA, a platform that digitizes hospital companion and eldercare services, after six months of market research. Target customers are the outsourcing firms that serve top-tier hospitals, though no contracts or revenue exist yet. A website, WeChat mini program and backend (React, Node.js, MySQL) are partly tested locally, with integration, permission isolation and deployment still to do; front- and back-end developers able to take over an existing codebase should reach out.

items.title: 黄仁勋为微软站台：没有 Windows 就不会有英伟达，Satya 当场“讨市值”
items.summary_zh: 微软在 10 月 8 日的 Windows 发布会上宣布引入“混合智能”：通过模型路由与 Windows ML，GitHub Copilot 等产品可按任务复杂度在云端和本地模型间切换，HydraFusion 将首次直接调用运行在 Windows PC 上的本地模型。黄仁勋与 Satya Nadella 同台回顾从 Windows 95、DirectX 到 CUDA 的合作，并判断 Agent 正成为新的“电脑用户”。当天微软股价微涨约 0.1%。
items.summary_en: At its October 8 Windows event, Microsoft introduced "hybrid intelligence": model routing and Windows ML let GitHub Copilot and other products switch between cloud and local models, and GitHub Copilot's HydraFusion will call local models running on Windows PCs directly. Jensen Huang and Satya Nadella traced the partnership from Windows 95, DirectX and CUDA to Azure's InfiniBand HPC, arguing agents are becoming a new kind of computer user. Microsoft shares rose roughly 0.1% that day.

items.title: [推广] 做了个小站：上传一张照片，生成 Jean Phil 风格的短视频
items.summary_zh: 作者周末做了个生成站 jeanphilai.org：上传一张正脸照，选场景、时长和西装颜色，几分钟就能生成一条 9:16 竖屏短视频，复刻 TikTok 上 Jean Phil 的打空拳梗。线稿按所选时长现裁，因此按秒计费；成片无声，需要自己配音乐。工具并非免费，成本来自视频模型。
items.summary_en: A developer built jeanphilai.org over a weekend: upload a frontal face photo, pick a scene, duration and suit color, and it returns a 9:16 vertical video in a few minutes, recreating the TikTok "Jean Phil" meme of a figure throwing air punches. Clips come out silent because the original music is copyrighted, and pricing is per second since the draft is cut to your chosen length. It is not free, given video-model costs.

items.title: [AI Tools 精品 AI 工具导航] 做了一个 Google Trends 上升词监控工具，适合 SEO 和选题研究
items.summary_zh: 作者做了个 Google Trends 上升词监控工具 Trends Monitor，可查询热度和上升相关查询，收藏词根、开启每日监控并查看历史快照。他把定位放在 SEO、内容选题和产品需求研究的线索收集上：先发现新词，再回看一段时间内的变化，避免只凭单次搜索下判断。
items.summary_en: Trends Monitor is a small tool for querying Google Trends interest and rising related queries; you can save root keywords, turn on daily monitoring and review historical snapshots. Its author uses it as a lead-collection aid for SEO, content planning and product research, finding new terms first and then tracking how they move over time instead of judging from a single search.

items.title: [分享创造] 做了个 Mistral AI 工作空间，聊天、对话管理和成本估算都放到了一起
items.summary_zh: mistrallarge4.io 是围绕 Mistral 做的 AI 工作空间，把聊天、系统提示词与温度设置、对话历史管理和成本估算放进同一界面。它支持流式输出、Markdown 与代码块、JSON 输出，可查看积分消耗和订阅，历史默认存在浏览器、可选云同步，并有中英文界面和移动端适配。作者注明该独立项目与 Mistral AI 官方无关。
items.summary_en: mistrallarge4.io is an AI workspace built around Mistral that puts chat, system-prompt and temperature settings, conversation history management and cost estimation in one place. It supports streaming output, Markdown and code blocks, JSON output, credit tracking and subscriptions, with history stored in the browser by default and optional cloud sync. The bilingual interface is mobile-friendly, and the author notes the independent project is not affiliated with Mistral AI.

items.title: [分享创造] 关于展示性网页+个人博客重构, 从 halo 和 wordpress 中摆脱出来, 意外发现很有意思的动静态结合的方法
items.summary_zh: 作者把两个站点分别从 WordPress 和 Halo 迁出：WordPress 扩展不便，Halo 的 Java 内存占用高，升级 2.22.x 后 slug 为纯数字的文章还会被错跳到归档页。新方案用 Go 写后端与动态管理端，内容变更时触发 Next.js 构建静态页再分发，并保留 MCP、AI 翻译、SEO 等动态能力。
items.summary_en: The author migrated two sites off WordPress and Halo: WordPress was awkward to extend, while Halo's Java backend used too much memory and, after the 2.22.x upgrade, articles with purely numeric slugs started landing on the archive page. The replacement pairs a Go backend and dynamic admin UI with a Next.js build triggered on content changes, serving the generated static pages while keeping MCP, AI translation and SEO tasks dynamic.

items.title: [分享创造] 把 Tripo Studio 连接到 Codex 的插件
items.summary_zh: Tripo Studio for Codex 是一个 MIT 许可的开源插件（最新 v0.3.4），它复用本机 Tripo Studio 网页端的登录会话和会员积分，无需再买 API Key。插件用 68 个 MCP 工具把 Studio 建模管线接进 Codex，覆盖 High Detail（H2.5/H3.0/H3.1）、500–25,000 面的 Smart Mesh P2 与 Rig V3 绑骨，并内嵌资产中心、任务队列等工作台。
items.summary_en: Tripo Studio for Codex is an MIT-licensed open-source plugin, now at v0.3.4, that reuses your local Tripo Studio browser session and membership credits instead of requiring separately billed API keys. It wires the Studio pipeline into Codex through 68 MCP tools, covering High Detail models, Smart Mesh P2 meshes of 500–25,000 faces and Rig V3 auto-rigging, plus an embedded workspace for asset management and task queues.

items.title: [分享创造] 关于自己的 agent-harness 的实践与迭代过程中一些好玩的点
items.summary_zh: 作者分享了自建 agent harness 的实践，思路借鉴 Codex 和 Claude Code，桌面端用 wails 写。文章讨论了 tool 的 round trip 调用与必须回传 result、agent 进程后台运行并在需要人工干预时发系统通知、四重 RAG 记忆、分层组装 prompt 和渐进式上下文压缩，以及用远程机器加固定容器唤起一次性容器执行沙箱脚本。
items.summary_en: The author walks through his own agent harness, whose design borrows heavily from Codex and Claude Code, with a desktop client written in wails. Topics include round-trip tool calls that must always return a result, running the agent as a background process that fires system notifications when human input is needed, four-layer RAG memory, layered prompt assembly with progressive context compression, and a remote-machine plus fixed-container setup that spins up throwaway containers for sandboxed scripts.

items.title: CLAUDE.md 还是 AGENTS.md？Anthropic 的答案是：以后都不用
items.summary_zh: Claude Code 团队确认将支持行业标准 AGENTS.md，此前它因拒绝兼容该文件遭到 Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke 的公开警告。核心成员 Thariq Shihipar 在 Latent Space 播客中更进一步：模型变强后，CLAUDE.md 这类静态指令文件最终可能不再需要，新项目可以先不写，只有反复看到同一失败模式再补规则。
items.summary_en: The Claude Code team has confirmed it will support AGENTS.md, the instruction-file standard it previously refused to adopt, a stance that drew a public warning from Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke. On the Latent Space podcast, core team member Thariq Shihipar went further: as models get stronger, static instruction files like CLAUDE.md may eventually become unnecessary, so new projects can skip them until the same failure keeps recurring.

items.title: 比 Astra 还贵！GPT-6.1 Sol 极速版上线，社区吐槽：“500 美元套餐都撑不过一天”
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 于 10 月 8 日在 Responses API 中为 9 月 29 日发布的 GPT-6.1 Sol 增加了 Ultrafast 极速档位，开发者无需更换模型名，只需把服务档位设为 ultrafast 即可调用。该档位被定位为最快的 API 服务层级，Token 单价是标准模式的 6 倍，面向对延迟敏感、愿意为速度付费的工作负载。
items.summary_en: On October 8, OpenAI added an Ultrafast service tier to GPT-6.1 Sol, the model it shipped on September 29, in the Responses API; developers keep the same model name and just set the tier to ultrafast. It speaks to developers who adopted AI tools and somehow feel more drained.
